in_sanskrit.name: Bishu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of happiness, pleasure
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bishu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bishu is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Vishu’, meaning happiness or pleasure. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is the preserver of the universe and the embodiment of happiness. The name Bishu is believed to bestow happiness and joy upon the bearer.
